item.title: EplayerX 1.2.1
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 优化预告片全屏观看入口与点击体验。 - 修复预告片字幕与标题、简介重叠的问题。 - 改善滚动和调整窗口大小时的字幕位置。 - 提供 Apple Silicon 和 Intel 两个独立安装包。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。
| Mac 芯片 | 下载 | | --- | --- | | Apple Silicon（M 系列） | [Apple Silicon 版](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx/releases/download/v1.2.1-macos/EplayerX-1.2.1-48-macOS-Apple-Silicon.zip) | | Intel | [Intel 版](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx/releases/download/v1.2.1-macos/EplayerX-1.2.1-48-macOS-Intel.zip) |
安装方法和已购用户切换步骤请见 [README](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx#readme)。
## What's New
- Improved the fullscreen trailer button and click handling. - Fixed trailer captions overlapping titles and descriptions. - Improved caption placement while scrolling and resizing the window. - Added separate downloads for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later.
| Mac processor | Download | | --- | --- | | Apple Silicon (M-series) | [Apple Silicon](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx/releases/download/v1.2.1-macos/EplayerX-1.2.1-48-macOS-Apple-Silicon.zip) | | Intel | [Intel](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx/releases/download/v1.2.1-macos/EplayerX-1.2.1-48-macOS-Intel.zip) |
See the [English README](https://github.com/liixing/eplayerx/blob/main/README.en.md) for installation and instructions for switching from the App Store version.
